worldcombat.skill.fireblast.summary: Burns a giant glyph into the air - a top bar, a left fall, a right fall lit one stroke at a time - then the whole glyph bursts at its heart, searing the target and possibly leaving a burn; the inscribe form leaves a scorching mark on the ground.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.0: Write a giant glyph in the air and burst it on the target
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.1: Leave a scorching mark on the ground with the inscribe form
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.2: A heavy special finisher at range
Three strokes form a %3$s block glyph; its burst covers a %2$s block radius, dealing %1$s special damage to each inside.
The glyph centre can drift up to %1$s blocks off the aim; strokes are %2$s s apart; a scorched target has a %3$s chance to burn.
The inscribe form leaves a %2$s block mark; standing on it takes %1$s every %4$s s for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.inscribe.on: Inscribe: burst power x0.85, but the embers leave a scorching mark that keeps burning anyone standing on it, +10 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.inscribe.off: Detonate: burst power x1.15, a heavier single hit and a shorter cooldown, but the glyph leaves no mark.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and the glyph to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power, the glyph to %3$s blocks and the burst radius to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.preference.i: On: burst power x0.85, but the embers leave a scorching mark that keeps burning anyone standing on it, +10 cooldown; use it to seal ground. Off (detonate): power x1.15, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown, but the glyph leaves no mark.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this heavy glyph; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
